svg.aria-label: D1, what the reply's link points at. Chosen: the report's session, resolved by Inbox, through to filed or not filed, given to the operator only. Instead of: the preview's suspension, or the session view. It comes down to when the reply is written: before the preview exists, so only the session id is known; and the session view is not where you answer. Price: for the few minutes of drafting, the link opens a still drafting note. Flips if replies were written only after the preview opens.
svg.text: What does the reply's Inbox link point at?
The preview's suspension, or the session view
The suspension does not exist yet when the reply is written. The
session view shows the run, but you answer in Inbox.
The report's session, resolved by Inbox
error-report~<id> exists from intake and never changes. Inbox
opens the item whose hold is in it; with none waiting it reads
the session's lines: still drafting, filed with the Linear ID,
or not filed. Given to the operator only.
When the reply is written: before the preview exists.
For the minutes of drafting, the link opens a still-drafting note.
Replies were written only after the preview opens.
